title: Second triangle identity for dualizable evaluation
statement: The second triangle identity in the conclusion of dualizable_evaluation_criterion holds.

proof.text: Apply the naturality and bifunctoriality calculation of Tag 0FPC to the evaluation pairing; the remaining formal categorical calculation is exactly the second zig-zag identity.

lean.statement: theorem dualizable_evaluation_second_triangle (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] (K D : schemeDerivedCategory X) (adj : ∀ A B C : schemeDerivedCategory X, (A ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op B, C)) ≃ (A ⊗ B ⟶ C)) (hadj : ∀ (A A' B B' C C' : schemeDerivedCategory X) (a : A' ⟶ A) (b : B' ⟶ B) (c : C ⟶ C') (f : A ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op B, C)), adj A' B' C' (a ≫ f ≫ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).map (b.op, c)) = (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫ adj A B C f ≫ c) (e : D ⊗ K ⟶ 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) (φ : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory X, M ⊗ D ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace) X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op K, M)) (hφ : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory X, IsIso (φ M)) (hφ_def : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory X, φ M = (adj (M ⊗ D) K M).symm ((α_ M D K).hom ≫ (𝟙 M ⊗ₘ e) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom)) (η : 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X) ⟶ K ⊗ D) (hη : η ≫ φ K = (adj (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) K K).symm ((λ_ K).hom)) : 𝟙 D = (ρ_ D).inv ≫ (𝟙 D ⊗ₘ η) ≫ (α_ D K D).inv ≫ (e ⊗ₘ 𝟙 D) ≫ (λ_ D).hom
